title: Subscription renewed
description: A period of a subscription was paid from the customer's wallet. Period 0 is the first one and is reported when the subscription starts. Billing only reports this fact: it never provisions or stops anything for the Tenant System, which decides what the renewal means for it. This schema describes the `data` member of the delivered document; the envelope (id, type, tenantId, occurredAt, data) is described in README.md.

periodNumber.description: Counted from the subscription's anchor; 0 is the first period.

chargeId.description: The charge that paid the period. Absent only for a plan whose recurring price is zero.

endsAtPeriodEnd.description: True when the subscription was canceled and ends when this period ends instead of renewing.

money.description: An amount in minor units (cents, dong) of one ISO 4217 currency.
